greeting: Well hello there, fellow WordPress whisperers and agency alchemists!
introParagraph: This week, the Release Radar is pinging with some seriously reimagined experiences and a few polished gems. While fixes were in short supply, the focus was firmly on enhancing user journeys and laying groundwork for future awesomeness, with one major player dropping a complete admin overhaul.

highlights.title: Thrive Themes 11.0
highlights.summary: Thrive Themes didn't just update; they 'reimagined' their entire admin experience! This massive overhaul promises a faster, sleeker, and more efficient workflow, built on a modern stack from dashboard to settings.

highlights.title: Envira Gallery Lite 1.16.0
highlights.summary: Envira Gallery Lite is giving us a peek into the Pro world with a new 'Submissions' tab. This addition cleverly showcases how visitor photo submissions work, enticing users to explore the full power of Envira Pro.

highlights.title: Smash Balloon Social Post Feed 4.13.0
highlights.summary: No more waiting a week for your social feeds to refresh! This update ensures Smash Balloon Social Post Feed now correctly honors your caching settings, keeping your content fresh and your visitors engaged.

highlights.title: PushEngage 4.2.10
highlights.summary: Mobile users rejoice! PushEngage has tidied up its Tools page, ensuring the Abilities detail drawer no longer spills off-screen, making management on the go much smoother. They've also improved documentation for MCP servers, which is always a win.

otherReleases.title: Smash Balloon Twitter Feed 2.9.0
otherReleases.shortSummary: Tweak: Tested and supported on WordPress 7.1

otherReleases.title: Smash Balloon YouTube Feed 2.9.0
otherReleases.shortSummary: Tweak: The upgrade link in the plugin's admin menu now reads "Upgrade to Pro"...

closingJoke: Why did the WordPress developer break up with the plugin? Because it had too many unresolved dependencies! Hopefully, your week's releases are more compatible.
